description: Defines a class PoStreamWriter that implements interfaces for writing Gettext PO streams, including methods for opening, closing, writing headers, items, and managing stream URI.

classes.name: PoStreamWriter
classes.description: A class for writing Gettext PO streams, implementing PoWriterInterface and PoStreamInterface.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets the PO header for the stream.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the stream for writing and writes the header.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream, throws exception if not open.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, throws exception on failure.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Writes the PO header to the stream.

methods.name: writeItem
methods.description: Writes a PO item to the stream.

methods.name: writeItems
methods.description: Writes multiple PO items from a reader.

methods.name: getURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the stream, throws exception if not set.

methods.name: setURI
methods.description: Sets the URI of the stream.
